notes: WMT is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Web Market Trade with symbol WMT and 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory during launch. WMT has no transfer fees or administrative powers and exposes no additional minting or burning functions. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
